parameters.query:
SELECT id, client_id, import_key, document_type, title, source_uri, checksum
FROM truth_documents
WHERE client_id = (SELECT id FROM clients WHERE code = 'SYNTH-ACME')
  AND status = 'RECEIVED' AND parsed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY received_at
